tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (refs 11, 12).

tokens.name: ground-document
tokens.usage: Background of a document or plan page (refs 13, 16).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, fields and rows set on the ground (refs 12, 15, 17).

tokens.name: surface-floating
tokens.usage: Glass, 78% opaque and blurred behind: controls that float over content: top buttons, the capsule, the tab bar, the round button (refs 11, 12).

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, frosted: 88% opaque and blurred (ref 13).

tokens.name: surface-popover
tokens.usage: Popover menus, frosted white (ref 17).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Chips, date chips and the search capsule (refs 11, 12).

tokens.name: chip-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in unselected chips (ref 12); 7.6:1 on fill.

tokens.name: checkbox-fill
tokens.usage: Inside an empty checkbox (ref 12).

tokens.name: segment-on
tokens.usage: A selected segment or tool in a sheet, with an accent-select edge (ref 13).

tokens.name: fill-sheet
tokens.usage: Tool buttons and soft buttons inside a sheet (ref 13).

tokens.name: fill-selected
tokens.usage: The pill behind the selected tab (ref 11).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: The one separator colour (v33, L9): every hairline, half a point on a retina screen.

tokens.name: separator-surface
tokens.usage: Hairlines on white cards and sheets (ref 16).

tokens.name: separator-sheet
tokens.usage: Dividers and button edges inside a sheet (refs 15, 17).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: One-point card edge when a card needs one (ref 12).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio rings (refs 12, 13). Non-text, 3:1 is not required for a decorative ring beside a label.

tokens.name: close
tokens.usage: The round close button in a popover header (ref 14).

tokens.name: grabber
tokens.usage: The 36 by 4 handle on a sheet (refs 13, 15).

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Titles, headings and row text; 15.2:1 on ground.

tokens.name: text-1-soft
tokens.usage: Task text and card titles; 11.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Captions, chip labels and any secondary WORDS; 4.7:1 on ground, 5.2:1 on surface. The references sample #7e8084 to #87898d here, which is 3.6:1, so words use this darker value.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Outline icons, placeholders and the search glass (refs 11, 12). Not for words on its own: 3.6:1 on ground.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Dots, the collapse chevron and other quiet marks. Never words.

tokens.name: text-4
tokens.usage: Counts beside a row and disabled marks. Never words that matter.

tokens.name: button-black
tokens.usage: The Done capsule (refs 13, 16); its label is on-black.

tokens.name: on-black
tokens.usage: Label on button-black; 15.9:1.

tokens.name: button-grey
tokens.usage: Cancel capsule in a pair (ref 17).

tokens.name: on-grey
tokens.usage: Label on button-grey; 6.6:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one blue, fill role (v33, L2): badges, buttons, the selected tab, the Now disc and the pointer. The same in both themes so white labels reach 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent.

tokens.name: accent-select
tokens.usage: Selection marks: the Now bar, radio dot, the check. The fill role of the one blue (v33).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The one blue, text role (v33): text buttons, links, the chip on the map; 4.5:1 or better on every wash it sits on.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected chip (ref 12).

tokens.name: accent-tint-edge
tokens.usage: Thin edge of a selected chip.

tokens.name: accent-on-tint
tokens.usage: Label of a selected chip; 6.3:1 on accent-tint.

tokens.name: now-block
tokens.usage: The selected block: Now on the plan (ref 13).

tokens.name: now-halo
tokens.usage: The soft halo around the Now block.

tokens.name: now-text
tokens.usage: Title inside the Now block; 4.7:1 on now-block.

tokens.name: bell-filled
tokens.usage: The filled bell when something waits for the owner: in ink, not a second blue (v33, L2); the blue dot says something waits.

tokens.name: selection-frame
tokens.usage: Frame around a selected card (ref 12).

tokens.name: groove
tokens.usage: The timeline's track, pressed into the page: the trunk and every branch (owner, 15 Nov 2026: option 4, groove).

tokens.name: groove-edge
tokens.usage: The light lower edge of a groove drawn as a line (a branch), where an inner shadow cannot go.

tokens.name: groove-main
tokens.usage: Main's groove, a shade darker than a branch's and 8 wide, so main stands out (owner, 15 Nov 2026: lane option C).

tokens.name: main-mark
tokens.usage: The disc behind an event icon on main; branch icons stay on fill.

tokens.name: on-main-mark
tokens.usage: The icon on a main-mark disc. In dark the disc recedes (v33, D3) so Now stays the brightest mark.

tokens.name: problem
tokens.usage: Problems only: an action that could not be finished, and a problem that came up (owner, 15 Nov 2026); 5.3:1 on white. status-bad takes the same value.

tokens.name: problem-wash
tokens.usage: The soft box behind a problem and what was done about it.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Status, on track or done (soft green): gauges, the check mark on an event. Not for words on its own (4.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: status-ok-wash
tokens.usage: Inside a green gauge's ring: status-ok 8% over surface (the tinted ring, A3).

tokens.name: status-ok-track
tokens.usage: A green gauge's track: status-ok 16% over surface.

tokens.name: status-ok-arc
tokens.usage: A green gauge's arc, the part filled by percent: status-ok 55% over surface.

tokens.name: status-ok-mark
tokens.usage: The disc of the small check on an event's icon (StatusMark).

tokens.name: status-wait
tokens.usage: Status, waiting on you or at risk (soft yellow): gauges, the hourglass mark, the map. Never words on its own.

tokens.name: status-wait-wash
tokens.usage: Inside a yellow gauge's ring: status-wait 8% over surface.

tokens.name: status-wait-track
tokens.usage: A yellow gauge's track: status-wait 16% over surface.

tokens.name: status-wait-arc
tokens.usage: A yellow gauge's arc: status-wait 55% over surface.

tokens.name: status-wait-mark
tokens.usage: The disc of the hourglass mark on an event's icon.

tokens.name: status-wait-dot
tokens.usage: A waiting event's dot on the branch map.

tokens.name: status-wait-tag
tokens.usage: Words of a waiting tag (Waiting on you, Awaiting merge) and the hourglass glyph; 4.7:1 on status-wait-tag-bg. Darkened from status-wait so words pass.

tokens.name: status-wait-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a waiting tag: status-wait 14% over surface.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Status, stopped, failed or blocked (soft red). The same value as problem: red keeps meaning a problem.

tokens.name: status-bad-wash
tokens.usage: Inside a red gauge's ring: status-bad 8% over surface.

tokens.name: status-bad-track
tokens.usage: A red gauge's track: status-bad 16% over surface; also the disc behind a failed event's icon on the map.

tokens.name: status-bad-arc
tokens.usage: A red gauge's arc: status-bad 55% over surface.

tokens.name: status-bad-mark
tokens.usage: The disc of the cross mark on an event's icon.

tokens.name: status-bad-dot
tokens.usage: A failed or blocked event's dot on the branch map.

tokens.name: status-bad-tag
tokens.usage: Words of a failed or blocked tag; 4.7:1 on status-bad-tag-bg.

tokens.name: status-bad-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a failed or blocked tag: status-bad 10% over surface.

tokens.name: map-window
tokens.usage: The soft blue window on the branch map that marks the events in view below.

tokens.name: groove-fill
tokens.usage: Fills the groove for work that is done, like a slider's fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a sheet or popover (refs 14, 15, 17).

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: The floating band behind the branch map: solid, with a 16-point fade under it (L1); in dark a step lighter than the ground (D1).

tokens.name: press-fill
tokens.usage: A row or tag while a finger is on it (M1).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One ramp (v33, L3): 11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 28. Weights 400 and 600; 700 only for the large and phase titles. Numbers that stack use tabular figures. The ring's 7.5 is the owner's own (R7 answer 11).

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per screen, 16 from the left; scrolls with the page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A phase's name in its heading.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: A milestone's name; a turning point's title; sheet titles.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: An event's title, a sprint's name (600), the pills.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Level labels in capitals, fourth numbers, the map's words.

spacing.note: Read from the references in points. 16 is the screen margin; 8 is the gap between chips and cards.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to dot; the Now bar width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the two capsules of a pair.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips and between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Sheet inset from the screen sides; between pinned cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen margin; row padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Tab bar from the left edge.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Separator stop from the right; between sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Above a large title, below the last section.

radius.note: Round, soft and capsule-shaped; nothing square. The scale in use (v33, L5): 6 tags, 12 inner boxes, row washes and bubbles, 20 cards, 28 sheets and menus, full pills; an inner radius is the outer one less the padding. 4 and 10 stay only for the checkbox and fields.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Date chip.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Fields, tool buttons, choice tiles.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Document cards and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Pinned and project cards.

tokens.name: radius-20
tokens.usage: Cards: home's groups, a plan (v33, L5).

tokens.name: radius-28
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and both menus (v33, L5 and C1).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules, chips, the tab bar, round buttons.

shadow.note: Soft and wide; floating controls lift, rows never do.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Top buttons, the capsule, the tab bar, the round button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Tiles and cards that sit on the ground.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Unselected chips: a light top edge, a darker bottom edge and a small drop, so they read as raised (owner, 15 Nov: the chips were missing 'that slight element of shadow').

tokens.name: shadow-chip-selected
tokens.usage: The selected chip: a white top edge, a rim darker at the bottom and a soft drop below, as in ref 12.

tokens.name: shadow-groove
tokens.usage: Presses the timeline's track into the page: a soft inner shadow and a light lower edge, the opposite of shadow-chip.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers.

motion.note: One curve, one spring, four durations (v33, docs/design/audit-2026-11-25-v32-polish.md, section 3). Overlays close as the reverse of their opening, from the same corner, at about 70% of its time. Reduced motion: no transforms or scroll animation; a 120 ms fade instead; presses stay as colour.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or moves.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves.

tokens.name: spring
tokens.value: stiffness 300, damping 30, mass 1 (about 0.35 s, no visible overshoot); as CSS linear() in build-v33/source/tokens.css
tokens.usage: Folds, menus, sheets, the page push, the map's events and window.

tokens.name: spring-bouncy
tokens.usage: Only a press releasing and a gauge landing.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: A finger going down: controls to scale .96, rows to press-fill, tags to 60%.

tokens.name: duration-small
tokens.usage: Bubbles; the pointer's wash and the map's arrow, together.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Folds opening (closing 240), the map's events sliding.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: Sheets; the page push (420); the Now jump (450 to 600 whatever the distance).

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height.

tokens.name: size-row

tokens.name: size-row-menu
tokens.usage: Popover row pitch.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: The separate round action button.

tokens.name: size-capsule
